CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION combat_consumer_private.narrative_allowed(p_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT CASE WHEN l.is_test THEN
   c.policy_id='staff_test_no_persistent_resources_v1'
   AND s.source_kind='ordinary' AND s.location_id=c.location_id
   AND NOT public.combat_v2_values_written(s.id)
   AND clan_marionettisti_private.roster_valid(s.id)
   AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.controller_user)
     FROM public.combat_v2_actors a
     JOIN combat_consumer_private.members m ON m.session_id=a.session_id
       AND m.actor_id=a.id AND m.character_id=a.character_id
     JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=a.character_id AND ch.user_id=a.controller_user
     WHERE a.session_id=s.id AND a.actor_kind='pg')=2
   AND combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed(l.id,
     ARRAY(SELECT a.controller_user FROM public.combat_v2_actors a
       WHERE a.session_id=s.id AND a.actor_kind='pg' ORDER BY a.controller_user),true)
 ELSE (SELECT enabled AND provider_enabled
   FROM combat_consumer_private.runtime_config WHERE singleton) END
 FROM combat_consumer_private.activities c
 JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions s ON s.id=c.session_id
 JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=c.location_id
 WHERE c.session_id=p_session AND c.phase<>'closed'),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clan_marionettisti_private.is_dedicated_scene(p_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from combat_spatial.arena_instances where encounter_id=p_session
   and (context_source in('marionetta_master','ordinary') or (context_source='panel_master' and exists(select 1 from public.combat_v2_sessions ms join combat_panel_private.master_panel_sessions mp on mp.master_session_id=ms.master_session_id where ms.id=p_session and ms.source_kind='master'))) and state='open'
   and exists(select 1 from public.combat_v2_actors a where a.session_id=p_session and a.companion_id is not null))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clan_marionettisti_private.narrative_attack_allowed(p_declaration uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.combat_v2_declarations d where d.id=p_declaration and d.kind='attacco'
  and (d.sanitized_intent#>>'{server_ability,source}'='mano' or exists(
   select 1 from clan_marionettisti_private.offensive_profiles p
   where p.declaration_id=d.id and p.round_id=d.round_id and p.owner_actor_id=d.actor_id
    and p.target_actor_id=d.target_actor_id and p.profile_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(p.profile)
    and d.sanitized_intent->>'ability_source'='clan'
    and d.sanitized_intent->>'ability_id'='e361f7c3-f90b-47ec-bfee-ccbda21257d9')))
$function$
